derivation: One class per core definition (its type's name; stereotype its kind; abstract as HL7 states; generalization the type its baseDefinition names) and one per backbone element (an element of the differential that has elements below it; named <Type>.<path>, owned by the class one level up, generalization the element's own type). A class's attributes are the differential's elements exactly one level below the class's element, with HL7's min, max, type codes (Reference and canonical targets by core type name), contentReference, isModifier and isSummary; an inherited element the differential only prohibits (max 0, as xhtml.extension) is kept as an attribute with no types. Inherited elements are not repeated: they are the generalization's. Constraints, bindings and descriptions are not copied: the cited definition holds them.
